one_line: Open with a POV headline in the first two seconds, then show each spoken claim in one static wide take.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 wide shot: a woman sits on the floor with a baby on her lap by a foam cube and ramp. Headline: "פוב הבת שלך מאוהבת בג״מבורי אז דאגת שיהיה לה גם בבית". Subtitles start at 0:00.
q1_hook.why: A POV headline names the viewer's situation, a parent whose child loves it, in the first frame (H1, T3, K6), with the product and a baby in view (S1, H2). Voice and word-by-word subtitles start together (H6). The woman is in profile, not facing the lens (H4 partly).

beats.what: She sits with the baby, touching the cube's hole; the POV headline
beats.why: The situation and the product in one frame

beats.what: She bends over and moves pieces, then sits on the pouf; "ואיך שראיתי", "ידעתי שאני"
beats.why: The personal reason: she saw the set and wanted it

beats.what: The baby climbs the steps and crawls into the cube's hole; "עדינים", "משתלב", "הוא מתנקה"
beats.why: The baby's moves vary the picture under the claims

beats.what: The baby climbs the cube, she holds her; she sits on the steps; "והכי חשוב, הוא מושלם"
beats.why: An adult sitting on it shows how solid it is

beats.what: She lifts the ramp off and separates the pieces; "אפשר לשנות את הסדר"
beats.why: Opens a new section: the modular idea

beats.what: A new layout, the ramp a triangle; the baby crawls under and leans on the cube; "ממש מתלהבת"
beats.why: The baby plays with the new layout

beats.what: She stacks the pieces against the wall; "ובסוף היום אני אוספת"
beats.why: The tidy end of the day closes the arc
A single pointer to the caption

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None in the video. Caption: a playful ask, "תודי לי אחרי זה" (thank me afterwards), tied to the website CTA; no question, tag, save or send ask.
q2_flow.why: A day arc, set up, play, rearrange, pack away, gives the Reel a shape (K2), and "אפשר לשנות את הסדר" at 0:17 opens a new section (R3). Spoken claims are mostly shown as they are said (R3). The ending, packing away, is a mild payoff (R4).

q3_cta.what: Written at 0:27 with a pointing-down emoji: "כל הפרטים בתיאור"; not in the transcript, so not said. Caption: "כנסי עכשיו לאתר של בליס ותודי לי אחרי זה" (go to Bliss's site now and thank me afterwards).
q3_cta.why: One action, go to the website (C1), shown at the end and repeated, with a joke, in the caption (C6). But the on-screen line lasts about 1 s with no voice, and the caption's first line does not carry the ask (C6).

q4_shown.what: The foam set (steps, cube with a round hole, ramp, pouf): the baby crawls through (0:07), the mother sits on the steps (0:13), takes the pieces apart (0:15), rearranges them (0:20) and stacks them away (0:24). No price, brand mark or cleaning shown.
q4_shown.why: Modular and tidy are shown as said (0:15 to 0:24); "easy to clean" is only said, and the colour claim shows one beige set (K5, F8). One adult handling the pieces alone shows it is simple (S4). The baby is on screen, which LumeBook's own Reels avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 10 wide static takes in 28 s, 2 to 5 s each, straight cuts, a few jump cuts between arrangements. Karaoke-style subtitles with the spoken word brightest. Headline 0:00 to 0:02. Ends on the pieces being stacked, with the CTA line.
q5_edit.why: Cuts every 2 to 5 s inside one scene fit the moderate pace (E2). Word-by-word subtitles with a highlighted active word track the voice (E4). It ends right after the last step, no tail (E8), at a length that fits a demo (R2).

q6_topic.what: A mother explains why she bought a foam play gym: it suits the living room, cleans easily, aids development and can be rearranged and packed away.
q6_topic.why: A POV headline puts the viewer in the shoes of a parent who already wants it for home (K6). The practical points, tidy, modular, living-room look, answer real home doubts (K4). The mood is warm and calm, with no peak or occasion (K1, K7 not met).

q7_filmed.what: Fixed phone camera, wide at eye level, in a bright living room with sheer curtains; the whole set and the woman fit in frame. Daylight from large windows. A woman in white and a baby of about 8 to 12 months.
q7_filmed.why: A steady wide frame in daylight shows the whole set and how one person moves it (F7, H8). The set is small in frame at times, so details rely on the voice (F4). Subtitles sit at 65 to 74% of frame height, at the edge of the bottom 35% (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: Headline at the top, 0:00 to 0:02, small white sans, two lines: "פוב הבת שלך מאוהבת בג״מבורי אז דאגת שיהיה לה גם בבית". Karaoke subtitles in white at 65 to 74% of the frame height, the spoken word brightest: "ואיך שראיתי" (0:02), "הוא מתנקה" (0:10), "אפשר לשנות את הסדר" (0:17), "כל הפרטים בתיאור 👇" (0:27). The child's name is subtitled at 0:00 to 0:01.
q8_text.caption: "מהרגע הראשון ידעתי שאני רוצה את הג׳ימבורי הזה" and the child's name. About 80 words: the brand's range, the pieces she chose, a CTA "כנסי עכשיו לאתר של בליס ותודי לי אחרי זה", last line "בשיתוף @bliss.il". No hashtags, no question.
q8_text.why: A Hebrew headline states the situation from the first frame (T3), and karaoke subtitles let a muted viewer follow (T1, T2), but they sit on the edge of the bottom 35% and the greyed words are weak (T4, T5). The caption has product keywords, no hashtags, and the disclosure comes last (T7, T8).

weak_points: The CTA is one unspoken line, about 1 s; "easy to clean" is said, not shown; the child's name is subtitled and in the caption; disclosure only on the caption's last line; subtitles at the edge of the bottom 35%.
lumebook_takeaway: Use a Hebrew POV headline in the first 2 s over a static phone shot, then show each claim as it is said; end with one clear CTA, hands only.
not_verified: Music (cannot hear). Whether the speaker is the account owner, and whether the baby is hers (the caption suggests so). The brand is not visible on the pieces. Price and terms are not stated. Corrections to src/coded: the CTA "כל הפרטים בתיאור" appears only at 0:27 and is not in the transcript, so it is written, not said; the headline is visible about 2 to 3 s.
